def.description: Victorian octagonal gazebo, 4 m across corners, 4.6 m tall. Deck: raised octagon 0.5 m with skirt, 2 entry steps (0.17/0.33) on +Z face. 8 turned lathe columns 2.6 m tall at corners; eave beams 0.15 m; fretwork triangle brackets at beam ends; railing 0.9 m (bottom rail, 7 balusters, top rail) on 7 faces, open at entrance; 8-sided concave slate roof from 3.1 to 4.2 m with alternating shingle bands, overhang to 1.25R; finial ball, pole and weather-vane arrow to 4.6 m. White painted wood, slate roof.
